name: web-how-it-works-four-step-list-with-numbered-timeline-and-icon-cards
title: 'A four-step path from blank page to launched site' with mono step numbers in circles on a vertical line and four bordered cards with icons
whatItIs: A white page with a tiny caps label 'HOW IT WORKS', a bold centred headline and a vertical timeline where circles with monospace numbers (01 to 04) sit beside wide hairline cards each with a small icon tile, a bold title (Browse the catalog, Install via shadcn, Customize without fear, Ship) and grey description.
whatItMeans: Clear and confident; a numbered line and quiet cards make a process feel simple.
techniques: Number steps in monospace circles on a vertical line.
Add a small icon tile per step.

vocabulary.definition: Steps marked by numbers on a vertical line.
A card with a very thin border.
A small rounded square holding an icon.
A tiny caps label above a heading.
